files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added

- Support for Nextcloud 35

### Changed

- Store user settings through `IUserConfig` instead of the deprecated `IConfig` user value methods
- Dependencies updates

### Removed

- Support for Nextcloud 32
- Support for PHP 8.1
